reconciliation.method: Same common paired support, positive design weights, archived weighted empirical left-CDF median/W1 conventions; every original month-repeat model/copy metric is checked.

public_aggregate_privacy_check: No raw userid/agent_id, original bins or prompt/reply text fields; only group/count aggregates.
limits: Exploratory, already inspected twelve periods; no new independent validation or identified cause.
Truth-defined stable/up/down buckets cannot be used prospectively.
